QuestInfo.name: [Operation: Dive] Setting Off
QuestInfo.0: Go meet up with Melin, who is waiting in the hallway, and depart for the parallel Magatia.
QuestInfo.1: As her instructor, you can't help but feel somewhat responsible for Melin's situation. Go to Magatia to help her resolve this mess.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived in the Magatia that Melin visited, but it's somewhat different than the other Magatias you've seen. For now, you should look around and get a feel of the situation on the ground.
